ModMetaData.name: No Loot
ModMetaData.author: pineappleLemonade67
ModMetaData.description:
Prevents non-player humanlike pawns (enemies, allies, traders) from dropping any loot. Gear is destroyed on death or downed. Recruited pawns keep their gear.
Features: - Master toggle: enable/disable the entire mod from the settings page - Per-faction exemption: pick which factions keep their loot via a searchable, mod-grouped list - Scrollable settings UI with search filter and collapsible mod groups
Requires Harmony.
